front: In Amazon RDS, can a Multi-AZ DB cluster run RDS for SQL Server?
back: No. It runs RDS for MySQL or RDS for PostgreSQL.
extra: Multi-AZ DB clusters [aren't available with the following engines](../facts/rds.md#rds-multi-az-cluster-engines-mysql-postgresql): Db2, MariaDB, Oracle and SQL Server.

front: In Amazon RDS, a vendor agent must run on the host operating system of a Microsoft SQL Server database. What do you use?
extra: RDS Custom lets you [customize your database environment and operating system](../facts/rds.md#rds-custom-os-access). Standard Amazon RDS [doesn't let you access the underlying host](../facts/rds.md#rds-custom-os-access).
